# Keep third-party defaults local, including projects with older policy baselines.
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0141 NEW)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0091 NEW)

if(NOT TARGET Yaml)
    add_subdirectory(MiniYaml EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL SYSTEM)
endif()
if(NOT TARGET NlohmannJson)
    add_subdirectory(NlohmannJson EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL SYSTEM)
endif()

if(NOT JRM_DISABLE_TESTS)
    if(TARGET GTest::gtest OR TARGET GTest::gmock)
        if(NOT TARGET GTest::gtest OR NOT TARGET GTest::gmock)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "JRM tests require both GTest::gtest and GTest::gmock.")
        endif()
    elseif(TARGET gtest OR TARGET gmock)
        if(NOT TARGET gtest OR NOT TARGET gmock)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "JRM tests require both gtest and gmock.")
        endif()
        add_library(GTest::gtest ALIAS gtest)
        add_library(GTest::gmock ALIAS gmock)
    else()
        if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/googletest/CMakeLists.txt")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Initialize the pinned dependencies/googletest submodule or set JRM_DISABLE_TESTS=ON.")
        endif()
        set(INSTALL_GTEST OFF)
        set(BUILD_GMOCK ON)
        set(gtest_build_tests OFF)
        set(gtest_build_samples OFF)
        add_subdirectory(googletest EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL SYSTEM)
    endif()
endif()

if(JRM_ENABLE_BENCHMARKS AND NOT TARGET benchmark::benchmark_main)
    if(TARGET benchmark::benchmark OR TARGET benchmark)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "JRM benchmarks require benchmark::benchmark_main from the existing dependency.")
    endif()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/benchmark/CMakeLists.txt")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Initialize the pinned dependencies/benchmark submodule or set JRM_ENABLE_BENCHMARKS=OFF.")
    endif()
    set(BENCHMARK_ENABLE_GTEST_TESTS OFF)
    set(BENCHMARK_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF)
    set(BENCHMARK_ENABLE_TESTING OFF)
    set(BENCHMARK_DOWNLOAD_DEPENDENCIES OFF)
    set(BENCHMARK_INSTALL_DOCS OFF)
    set(BENCHMARK_INSTALL_TOOLS OFF)
    add_subdirectory(benchmark EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL SYSTEM)
endif()
